chunks: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.
ai.seo_question: Who is the Lord of Moses and Aaron according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Ash-Shu'ara, the polytheists cite this phrase as a common refrain of Moses and Aaron to assert their monotheistic authority against Pharaoh, highlighting the continuity of prophetic mission. Shia exegesis often views this as a testament to the universal message of Tawhid (Oneness of God) proclaimed by all prophets, reinforcing the legitimacy of their divine mandate.
